findings.title: Unverifiable review claim without a reference
findings.message: The README says the internal review reports no unresolved findings, but gives no link or identifier for the review. It also points to earlier controller-fault records without naming them. A reader cannot trace these assertions to anything.
findings.suggestion: Link the internal review record and the preserved controller-fault and failed-soak records by path or archive-index entry.
findings.evidence: findings. The earlier controller-fault and failed-soak records remain preserved.

finding.title: Referenced evidence artifacts are not part of this change
finding.message: The report's central claims (PASS_SCOPED_NATIVE_CASE, SHA-256 of the raw log, the qualification binding, the internal review result) rest on files under `records/`. None of those files is in this diff. If they are not committed elsewhere, the links and claims cannot be checked, and the specs point at a result nobody can verify.
finding.suggestion: Confirm that `records/archive-index.json`, `records/evidence.tar.xz` and `records/qualification.json` are committed in the same change, or state where they are stored (for example an artifact store with its hash).
